:::{#hero-heading}

I am an Assistant Professor of Biostatistics and Health Data Science at the University of Pittsburgh School of Public Health.

My work focuses on **statistics education**, **large-scale electronic health record and network data analysis**, and **obesity and cardiometabolic health**.

I am particularly interested in helping students develop statistical reasoning and use statistical methods thoughtfully in public health research.

## Education

- **PhD, Biostatistics**, Johns Hopkins University, 2023
- **BA, Mathematics**, Cornell University, 2018

## Academic interests

- Statistics education
- Large-scale electronic health record and network data analysis
- Obesity and cardiometabolic health

:::
